Cannot be exercised on web preview; would work on Expo Go / native build. Zero page errors, zero red screens. Deprecated packages detected: react-native-vector-icons vs @react-native-vector-icons/feather (already using scoped variant, OK); ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions deprecation was already fixed in iter4 (upload.tsx now uses mediaTypes: ['images']).

integration_issues.issue: Tapping 'Pay ₹1239 securely' opens the RazorpayCheckout Modal but the body renders 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' because /app/frontend/src/components/razorpay-checkout.tsx line 3 imports { WebView } from 'react-native-webview' which has NO web implementation. The Razorpay order IS created (POST /api/payments/razorpay/order -> 200, twice due to StrictMode double-invocation of the useState-as-effect trick at line 42-44) but the hosted checkout page /api/payments/razorpay/checkout/{rp_order_id} is never rendered. On web this blocks the entire payment step. Works on native builds only. Recommendation: platform-branch (Platform.OS === 'web') and render an <iframe src=checkoutUrl> or use the Razorpay Standard Checkout JS SDK (rzp = new Razorpay(options); rzp.open()) for web.

react_native_issues.issue: razorpay-checkout.tsx uses <WebView /> from react-native-webview which is not supported on web (renders 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.'). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/razorpay-checkout.tsx:3,90-99. Needs a Platform.OS==='web' branch (iframe or Razorpay JS SDK).

Line 42 useState(() => { if (visible) start(); }) and line 44 fallback both attempt to trigger start on open — this fires twice in React 18 StrictMode (observed: 2 identical POST /api/payments/razorpay/order calls in devtools). Should be replaced by a proper useEffect([visible]) to avoid duplicate order creation.

action_items: HIGH: Make Razorpay checkout work on web. In /app/frontend/src/components/razorpay-checkout.tsx add a Platform.OS==='web' branch that either (a) embeds an <iframe src={checkoutUrl} /> instead of <WebView /> and receives postMessage from the backend-hosted checkout page, or (b) uses the Razorpay Standard Checkout JS SDK directly (script src=https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js, new Razorpay({ key: rzp_test_TaeOBeX1L1gDcd, order_id, handler }).open()). rca_of_issue: Razorpay Pay on web preview fails silently to the user: (1) User taps checkout-pay-button. (2) Backend creates an order (POST /api/orders returns 200) and RazorpayCheckout Modal is opened. (3) Modal auto-invokes start() which calls POST /api/payments/razorpay/order — returns 200 with razorpay_order_id and provider=razorpay. (4) Component tries to render <WebView source={{ uri: `${BASE}/api/payments/razorpay/checkout/${rpOrderId}` }} /> from react-native-webview. (5) react-native-webview has no web implementation — the RN-web shim renders a Text node 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.'. (6) checkout.razorpay.com JS SDK is therefore never loaded, key rzp_test_TaeOBeX1L1gDcd never appears in the DOM, and the user is stuck on the Secure Checkout modal with only the 'x' close button. Mitigation: Platform.OS==='web' branch to render an <iframe src={checkoutUrl}> (backend page already exists and would work in an iframe) OR to load Razorpay Standard Checkout JS SDK directly (script + new Razorpay(opts).open()). Both approaches keep the existing native WebView flow intact via a simple Platform.select.
